DETAIL: Repair the derived-value tolerance constraint: the current branches use only relative tolerance for every positive or negative midspanPlasticCollapseLoad and use the absolute 1e-9 tolerance only for exactly zero, so sufficiently small nonzero expected values receive an unnecessarily tighter tolerance. Use evaluator-supported piecewise arithmetic or min/max to set tolerance to max(1e-6 * magnitude of the expected midspanPlasticCollapseLoad, 1e-9), with magnitude expressed without ABS, and retain inclusive bounds, the demand <= plasticStrength check, and the existing bottom-only orientation and side-transverse applicability.
